pairs: Post dies multos factum est verbum Domini ad Eliam,
the word of the Lord came to Elijah,
ut dem pluviam super faciem terræ.
so that I may grant rain upon the face of the earth.”
Elijah went to show himself to Ahab.
erat autem fames vehemens in Samaria.
For there was a severe famine in Samaria.
Vocavitque Achab Abdiam dispensatorem domus suæ:
And Ahab called Obadiah, the manager of his household.
Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly.
Nam cum interficeret Jezabel prophetas Domini,
For when Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord,
And he fed them with bread and water.
Vade in terram ad universos fontes aquarum,
for perhaps we will be able to find plants,
and save the horses and mules,
so that the beasts of burden may not perish entirely.”
Diviseruntque sibi regiones ut circuirent eas:
And they divided the regions among themselves,
so that they might travel through them.
et Abdias per viam alteram seorsum.
Ahab went one way alone, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
And while Obadiah was on the way,
Elias occurrit ei: qui cum cognovisset eum,
Elijah met him. And when he had recognized him,
cecidit super faciem suam, et ait:
he fell on his face, and he said,
Num tu es, domine mi, Elias?
Vade, et dic domino tuo: Adest Elias.
Go and tell your lord that Elijah is here.”
“How have I sinned that you would deliver me,
quoniam tradis me servum tuum in manu Achab,
so that he would put me to death?
As the Lord your God lives,
quia non est gens aut regnum quo non miserit dominus meus te requirens:
there is no nation or kingdom to which my lord has not sent, seeking you.
et respondentibus cunctis: Non est hic:
And when all responded, ‘He is not here,’
he swore each kingdom and nation to an oath,
because you were not found at all.
and tell your lord that Elijah is here.’
And when I will have departed from you,
spiritus Domini asportabit te in locum quem ego ignoro:
the Spirit of the Lord will transport you to a place that I do not know.
And entering, I will report to Ahab.
servus autem tuus timet Dominum ab infantia sua.
Yet your servant has feared the Lord from his infancy.
Numquid non indicatum est tibi domino meo quid fecerim cum interficeret Jezabel prophetas Domini,
Has it not been revealed to you,
quod absconderim de prophetis Domini centum viros,
what I did when Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord:
how I hid one hundred men from the prophets of the Lord,
and how I fed them with bread and water?
Vade, et dic domino tuo: Adest Elias:
‘Go and tell your lord that Elijah is here,’
so that he may kill me!”
this day I will appear to him.”
Abiit ergo Abdias in occursum Achab,
Therefore, Obadiah went away to meet Ahab,
et indicavit ei: venitque Achab in occursum Eliæ.
and he reported to him. And Ahab went to meet Elijah.
And when he had seen him, he said,
Tune es ille, qui conturbas Israël?
“Are you the one who is disturbing Israel?”
and the house of your father,
who have abandoned the commandments of the Lord,
et congrega ad me universum Israël in monte Carmeli,
send and gather to me all of Israel, on Mount Carmel,
with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal,
and the four hundred prophets of the sacred groves,
who eat from the table of Jezebel.”
Misit Achab ad omnes filios Israël,
Ahab sent to all the sons of Israel,
et congregavit prophetas in monte Carmeli.
and he gathered together the prophets on mount Carmel.
Accedens autem Elias ad omnem populum,
Then Elijah, drawing near to all the people,
“How long will you waver between two sides?
Et non respondit ei populus verbum.
And the people did not respond a word to him.
Et ait rursus Elias ad populum:
And Elijah said again to the people:
“I alone remain as a prophet of the Lord.
prophetæ autem Baal quadringenti et quinquaginta viri sunt.
But the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.
Let two oxen be given to us.
et illi eligant sibi bovem unum,
And let them choose one ox for themselves,
et in frusta cædentes ponant super ligna,
and, cutting it into pieces, let them set it on the wood.
But they may not place fire under it.
And I will prepare the other ox,
and set it on the wood.
But I will not place fire under it.
Call upon the names of your gods.
et ego invocabo nomen Domini mei:
And I will call on the name of my Lord.
et Deus qui exaudierit per ignem,
And the God who will have heeded with fire,
And in response, all the people said,
Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal:
And call on the names of your gods,
but do not place fire under it.”
Qui cum tulissent bovem quem dederat eis,
And when they had taken an ox, which he had given to them,
et invocabant nomen Baal de mane usque ad meridiem, dicentes:
And they called on the name of Baal, from morning even until midday,
And so they leaped upon the altar that they had made.
And when it was now midday,
or certainly he may be asleep,
Then they cried out with a loud voice,
et incidebant se juxta ritum suum cultris et lanceolis,
and they cut themselves, in accord with their ritual, with knives and lancets,
until they were entirely covered in blood.
et illis prophetantibus venerat tempus quo sacrificium offerri solet,
and they were prophesying, the time had arrived when the sacrifice is usually offered.
And there was no voice heard,
nec aliquis respondebat, nec attendebat orantes,
neither did anyone heed or respond to the praying.
Elijah said to all the people,
And as the people were drawing near to him,
curavit altare Domini quod destructum fuerat.
he repaired the altar of the Lord, which had been torn down.
Et tulit duodecim lapides juxta numerum tribuum filiorum Jacob,
And he took twelve stones, in accord with the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob,
ad quem factus est sermo Domini,
to whom the word of the Lord came,
Et ædificavit de lapidibus altare in nomine Domini:
And he built from the stones an altar to the name of the Lord.
And he made a trench for water,
quasi per duas aratiunculas in circuitu altaris,
like two furrows of plowed land, all around the altar.
and he cut the ox into pieces,
and he placed it on the wood.
et ait: Implete quatuor hydrias aqua,
And he said, “Fill four containers with water,
et fundite super holocaustum et super ligna.
and pour it over the holocaust, and over the wood.”
And when they had done it a second time,
he said, “Do it also a third time.”
And they did so a third time.
And the water was running down around the altar,
and the pit of the trench was filled with water.
Cumque jam tempus esset ut offerretur holocaustum,
And when it was now time for the holocaust to be offered,
the prophet Elijah, drawing near, said:
ostende hodie quia tu es Deus Israël,
reveal this day that you are the God of Israel,
and that I am your servant,
et juxta præceptum tuum feci omnia verba hæc.
and that I have acted, in all these things, in accord with your precept.
ut discat populus iste quia tu es Dominus Deus,
so that this people may learn that you are the Lord God,
et tu convertisti cor eorum iterum.
and that you have converted their heart again.”
Then the fire of the Lord fell down
et aquam quæ erat in aquæductu lambens.
and it absorbed the water that was in the trench.
And when all the people had seen it,
et ne unus quidem effugiat ex eis.
and do not let even one of them escape.”
And when they had apprehended them,
duxit eos Elias ad torrentem Cison,
Elijah led them down to the torrent Kishon,
and he put them to death there.
et bibe, quia sonus multæ pluviæ est.
For there is the sound of an abundance of rain.”
Ascendit Achab ut comederet et biberet:
Ahab ascended, so that he might eat and drink.
Elias autem ascendit in verticem Carmeli,
But Elijah ascended to the top of Carmel,
et pronus in terram posuit faciem suam inter genua sua,
and bending down to the ground, he placed his face between his knees.
And he said to his servant,
and gaze out toward the sea.”
And again, he said to him,
ecce nubecula parva quasi vestigium hominis ascendebat de mari.
behold, a little cloud ascended from the sea like the footstep of a man.
And as he was turning himself this way and that,
and there were clouds and wind,
et manus Domini facta est super Eliam,
And the hand of the Lord was upon Elijah.
